title: FFT AI — Drift Monitor v1.33
description: Enforces drift=bounded invariant (INV-004). Tracks cumulative drift delta across all operator applications and enforces the delta_max ceiling.

monitoring.delta_calc: sum of drift_cost values for all operators since last Stabilization
monitoring.on_alert: emit DRIFT WARNING to session.log; reduce autonomy mode if AM-003+
monitoring.on_exceed: halt operator dispatch; invoke Stabilization; log DRIFT ERROR; emit paradox PX-003 if 3+ consecutive

drift_accounting.cross_regime: isolated — each regime has independent delta counter

reset_trigger: Stabilization operator application resets delta to 0.00
